description.narrative: Reporting is an important management tool which is used to inform relevant government officials and other stakeholders about the results being achieved by individual projects and the programme as a whole. For project partners, it is compulsory to use the prescribed Orange Knowledge annual report format in order to report on project achievements. The annual report also provides valuable data on the financial situation of the project. Based on an analysis of the project performance in relation to the project output(s) and expected outcome(s), a revision of the project work plan may be suggested by the project partners. The consequences of a possible revision on the project work plan and budget must be made clear in the annual report. Nuffic monitors outputs and outcomes and not activities. Therefore, the main focus of the annual report must be on the achievement of the project’s output(s) and planned outcome(s). The information provided in the annual reports of the projects is used by Nuffic to monitor the progress of the project and to inform the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and other stakeholders about the output(s) and outcome(s) being achieved by individual projects and the Orange Knowledge programme as a whole. Please note that if project progress is in accordance with the original planning, reporting requirements are minimal. Only in case of deviations from the planning, more elaboration is demanded. In the Grant Obligations and Conditions, the obligatory dates for submission of the annual/additional reports are mentioned. The final report must reflect on the entire project period.

title.narrative: 2. Project progress and achievement

description.narrative:
In this section (maximum 1000 words), please
**For TMT+:**
Comment to what extent the outputs have been achieved. Comment on the activities that have taken place and the most important milestones.

actual.value:
At the start of the project, we defined 3 different subsectors: irrigation, horticulture and animal production.
Each subsector defined some different learning lessons, and sub divisions, for example for animal production we made a choice of animals on which we would focus.
For each subsector, we pointed out 2-3 teachers (experts) from the Netherlands, who are experts in these areas, and we also divided the groups within the schools into 3 groups: horticulture, irrigation and animal production.
All groups started to do there courses and trainings and practicals independantly, during the 3 years of the project. We tried to have the same amount of training days for each group, although we were also dependant on the availability of the different dutch experts.
Each expert and each group made it's own curriculum, and we tried to have different goals and intermediate steps for the participants. For example, we had several excercises which the participants should do, in groups or individually, during the training. The groups made presentations, reports, and also practical projects.
The milestones were set after each trainingweek: the experts evaluated the students, and the student (participants) also made an evaluation each time of the training. From there on, it was asked what they needed more, so the next training was adapted to this.
At the end, each group and each school had to prepare a project, which is 50% financied by the TMT, and the rest by the schools. In this way, the participants are continuing there work and knowledge after the project TMT is completed. We are in the stage of accepting the project and financing them. We hope the project can continue for another year. The projects are very practical, because this is what they asked for.

Until the 1st of April, different course have been given to the teachers of the schools. We devided the teachers(participants) into 3 groups: irrigation, horticulture and animal production. We made a enquiry in order to get to know the subjects on which the participants wanted to know more. With those subjects, each group defined the exact subjects on which the online training would be given, in different modules.
The courses of Irrigation and Animal production started already, succesfully, online. Animal production also had a practical training locally. Horticulture did not start yet.

comment.narrative: 28-07-2023: Les employeurs seront très satisfaits des compétences et connaissances de nos futurs diplômés. En effet, les fururs diplômés ayant bénéficié au cours de leur apprentissage la transmission de nouveaux savoir faire et savoir être feront preuve de grande compétence auprès de leur futurs employeur qui sera très satisfait de leur prestation/service. Employers will be very satisfied with the skills and knowledge of our future graduates. Indeed, graduate fururs who have benefited during their apprenticeship from the transmission of new know-how and life skills will demonstrate great competence to their future employer who will be very satisfied with their performance/service.
